_comment: Random events for any game. eras: [from, to] years (negative = BC). regimes: the regime the movement rises against (empty = any). needs: agrarian, industrial, front, rear or world. Placeholders: {commune}, {neighbour}, {enemy}, {region}, {state}, {stateId}. Built by hand; see README.

event.title: A bumper harvest in {commune}
event.text: The granaries of {commune} are full to the rafters, more than it can eat in a year.

options.label: Share it across the federation
options.description: Carts go out to every commune. Others will remember.

options.label: Keep it in {commune}
options.description: Its people eat well; its neighbours notice.

event.title: Drought around {commune}
event.text: No rain for weeks. The wells of {commune} are low and the crops are failing.

options.label: Neighbours send grain
options.description: {neighbour} and the others share what they have.

options.label: Each fends for itself
options.description: {commune} goes hungry.

event.title: Fire in {commune}
event.text: A fire has swept through {commune}'s workshops and houses.

options.label: Rebuild together
options.description: Volunteers come from {neighbour} and beyond.

options.label: {commune} rebuilds alone
options.description: Slower, and bitter.

event.title: Refugees reach {commune}
event.text: Families fleeing the {enemy} arrive in {commune} with nothing but what they carry.

options.label: Take them in
options.description: More mouths, more hands, more stories of what the {enemy} does.

options.label: Turn them away
options.description: Guards on the roads. A habit hard to unlearn.

event.title: {commune} and {neighbour} quarrel over water
event.text: Both say the stream is theirs. Its mill and its fields can't both have it all.

options.label: Mediate a shared rota
options.description: Delegates sit with both assemblies until there is a schedule.

options.label: Let them settle it
options.description: They do, with sticks.

event.title: A festival in {commune}
event.text: {commune} is holding its first festival since the rising, with music, dancing and long tables in the square.

options.label: Invite the whole federation
options.description: Delegates and families come from every commune.

options.label: Keep it local
options.description: A good night for {commune}.

event.title: A spy in {commune}
event.text: A courier for the {enemy} has been caught carrying maps of {commune}'s defences.

options.label: Expose the network publicly
options.description: An open trial before the assembly.

options.label: Set up a security committee
options.description: Watchers, files and informers — it works.

event.title: An officer of the {enemy} defects
event.text: A seasoned officer of the {enemy} comes over with his men and his maps. He expects a command.

options.label: Give him a command
options.description: Experience the militias lack. And an officer who expects obedience.

options.label: He serves in the ranks
options.description: His men are welcome; his rank is not.

event.title: Hoarding in {commune}
event.text: Some households in {commune} have been hiding grain while their neighbours go short.

options.label: Shame them in the assembly
options.description: The grain comes out, and so does resentment.

options.label: Requisition it
options.description: Patrols search the cellars.

event.title: The river floods {commune}
event.text: The river has burst its banks around {commune}. Fields and storehouses are under water.

options.label: Everyone to the dykes
options.description: Every commune nearby sends hands.

options.label: Save what can be saved
options.description: {commune} loses its stores.

event.title: A traveller in {commune}
event.text: A wandering millwright has arrived in {commune} and offers to show how to harness the river.

options.label: Welcome them, and spread it
options.description: Mills along the river.

options.label: Send them on their way
options.description: Strangers bring trouble.

event.title: A printer in {commune}
event.text: A journeyman printer with type in his pack asks for a room in {commune}.

options.label: Give the press a home
options.description: Broadsheets within the month.

options.label: Send him on his way
options.description: Letters are for priests and lawyers.

event.title: An engineer in {commune}
event.text: A railway engineer, sacked for organizing, offers to teach what he knows in {commune}.

options.label: Give them a workshop
options.description: Engines, wires and a night school.

options.label: No experts
options.description: The federation trains its own.

event.title: Hackers in {commune}
event.text: A group of programmers from abroad wants to set up a network between the communes.

options.label: Let them build it
options.description: Assemblies online, open to all.

options.label: Keep the old ways
options.description: Meetings in person, as before.

event.title: A comet over {region}
event.text: A comet hangs in the night sky. The priests of the {enemy} say the gods condemn the rising.

options.label: Mock the omen
options.description: Speakers explain what comets are, and what priests are for.

options.label: Declare it our sign
options.description: The comet is ours. Prophets are useful — and hard to unmake.

event.title: Gladiators break out
event.text: The fighters of a school near {commune} have killed their masters and ask to join the federation.

options.label: Welcome them as fighters
options.description: Trained men, and a legend in the making.

options.label: Welcome them as equals
options.description: They lay down their swords and take up tools.

event.title: Raiders strike {commune}
event.text: Raiders from beyond the frontier have struck the villages around {commune}, taking cattle and captives.

options.label: Pay them off
options.description: Gifts and grain, and they ride away.

options.label: Arm the villages
options.description: Watchtowers, beacons and drilled militias.

event.title: The clans offer kinship
event.text: Elders of the clans that follow the {enemy} offer to swear kinship with the communes, as their custom is.

options.label: Swear kinship
options.description: Feasts and marriages; some of the {enemy}'s warriors go home.

options.label: Stay apart
options.description: The federation keeps its own ways.

event.title: A great gift-feast
event.text: Custom says that a people's worth is shown by what it gives away. {commune} proposes a great feast for every band and village.

options.label: Hold the feast
options.description: Everything shared, everyone bound together.

options.label: Keep the stores
options.description: Lean times may come.

event.title: The high priest's offer
event.text: The high priest of the {enemy} offers to bless the federation if its assemblies sacrifice at his temple.

options.label: Refuse
options.description: No priests above the assemblies.

options.label: Accept the blessing
options.description: The pious are reassured; the priests gain a voice.

event.title: The tithe collectors
event.text: Collectors from the {enemy} demand the tenth of every harvest, as before the rising.

options.label: Refuse the tithe
options.description: Not a sheaf.

options.label: Pay it, to buy peace
options.description: Grain for quiet, for a while.

event.title: A relic in {commune}
event.text: The bones of a saint lie in {commune}'s church. Pilgrims still come, and the priests want them back.

options.label: The commune keeps it
options.description: Pilgrims, fairs and pride.

options.label: Sell it for arms
options.description: Silver for the militias. The faithful are scandalized.

event.title: Excommunicated
event.text: The {enemy}'s priests have cursed the federation: no sacraments, no burials, no marriages in the communes.

options.label: Preach that God is with the poor
options.description: Hedge preachers and lay brothers take the pulpits.

options.label: Seek reconciliation
options.description: Envoys to the bishop. The price is obedience.

event.title: The manor rolls burn
event.text: The peasants of {commune} have burned the lord's rolls of rents and services.

options.label: Celebrate
options.description: No more dues. The lord's friends gather.

options.label: Restrain them
options.description: Order first; the rolls can wait.

event.title: Accusations of witchcraft
event.text: Neighbours in {commune} accuse an old healer of witchcraft and want her tried.

options.label: Forbid the trial
options.description: The assembly protects her. Some grumble.

options.label: Let the assembly judge
options.description: A trial, a verdict, and fear.

event.title: Privateers offer a captured cargo
event.text: A privateer captain has a hold full of muskets taken from a royal ship, and will sell.

options.label: Buy the cargo
options.description: Muskets for the front.

options.label: No dealings with pirates
options.description: The federation keeps clean hands.

event.title: The imperial levy
event.text: Imperial officers are rounding up young men for the legions in the villages near {commune}.

options.label: Hide the young
options.description: Cellars, forests and false papers.

options.label: Let them go
options.description: Fewer quarrels with the army, for now.

event.title: A governor wants to switch sides
event.text: A provincial governor of the {enemy} offers his province's garrison — if he keeps his palace and his title.

options.label: Accept
options.description: A garrison and a governor.

options.label: Refuse
options.description: No governors in the federation.

event.title: The government calls elections
event.text: To split the movement, the government promises free elections and an amnesty for those who take part.

options.label: Boycott
options.description: No votes for masters.

options.label: Stand candidates
options.description: Deputies in parliament, and a party to send them.

event.title: The king offers a constitution
event.text: The court offers a charter: a parliament, a free press, and the crown above all.

options.label: Refuse
options.description: The communes need no charter.

options.label: Negotiate
options.description: Delegates to the palace. A truce, and ministries.

event.title: Squads march on {commune}
event.text: Uniformed squads of the {enemy} are marching on {commune} to burn its union halls.

options.label: Meet them in the streets
options.description: The whole town turns out.

options.label: Barricade and wait
options.description: The halls hold. The squads roam the countryside.

event.title: The party's commissars arrive
event.text: Commissars of the {enemy}'s party offer to 'help' the communes organize, with arms and discipline.

options.label: Debate them in the assemblies
options.description: Arguments in every hall.

options.label: Let them organize
options.description: Discipline, rifles — and cells.

event.title: A general strike spreads
event.text: Workers far beyond the federation have struck in solidarity. The {enemy}'s supply lines stall.

options.label: Support the strike
options.description: Food and money for the strikers.

options.label: Keep the factories running
options.description: Production for the front comes first.

event.title: Machines break down in {commune}
event.text: The main machines in {commune}'s works have broken down, and parts are scarce.

options.label: Pool spare parts
options.description: Every workshop gives something.

options.label: Buy parts abroad
options.description: Fast, and through middlemen.

event.title: Sanctions on the federation
event.text: {state} leads a campaign of sanctions: no trade, no credit, no spare parts.

options.label: Turn to self-reliance
options.description: Hard times, made together.

options.label: Lobby {state}
options.description: Delegations, petitions, concessions.

event.title: A journalist from {state}
event.text: A well-known journalist from {state} asks to report from the communes.

options.label: Show everything, warts and all
options.description: An honest report; not all of it flattering.

options.label: Show the model communes
options.description: A glowing report, and a press office.

event.title: A rumour spreads online
event.text: Posts claim that {commune} is hoarding medicine. Other communes are angry.

options.label: Open its books
options.description: Anyone can check the stores.

options.label: Ignore it
options.description: It will blow over. It doesn't.
